item.title: Huntingdon and Fulton counties placed under a cold weather advisory Saturday and Sunday
item.description: At 2:03 a.m. on Friday, the National Weather Service released a cold weather advisory valid from Saturday 4 a.m. until Sunday 10 a.m. for Huntingdon and Fulton counties.

item.title: Extreme cold warning issued for Pa. Wilds for Saturday and Sunday – dangerously cold wind chills
item.description: On Friday at 2:03 a.m. an extreme cold warning was issued by the National Weather Service valid from Saturday 1 a.m. until Sunday 10 a.m. for Warren, McKean, Potter, Elk, Cameron and Tioga counties.

item.title: Extreme cold warning in place for Central Pa. for Saturday and Sunday – dangerously cold wind chills
item.description: On Friday at 2:03 a.m. the National Weather Service issued an extreme cold warning valid from Saturday 1 a.m. until Sunday 10 a.m. for Northern Centre as well as Clearfield, Cambria, Blair, Somerset and Bedford counties.

item.title: Extreme cold warning for Southern Centre for Saturday and Sunday – wind chills as low as -25
item.description: On Friday at 2:03 a.m. an extreme cold warning was released by the National Weather Service valid from Saturday 1 a.m. until Sunday 10 a.m. for Southern Centre.

item.title: Central Pa. under a wind advisory Saturday – winds gusting up to 55 mph
item.description: On Friday at 2:03 a.m. a wind advisory was issued by the National Weather Service valid for Saturday between 4 a.m. and 10 p.m. for Mifflin, Juniata, Franklin, Union, Snyder, Montour, Northumberland, Columbia, Perry, Dauphin, Schuylkill, Lebanon, Cumberland, Adams, York and Lancaster counties.

item.title: Extreme cold warning in place for North Central Pa. for Saturday and Sunday – dangerously cold wind chills
item.description: At 2:03 a.m. on Friday, the National Weather Service issued an extreme cold warning valid from Saturday 1 a.m. until Sunday 10 a.m. for Northern Clinton and Northern Lycoming as well as Sullivan County.

item.title: Southern Centre under a wind advisory Saturday – gusts as high as 50 mph
